transcriptEntries.text: What would you like next week's lesson to help students practice?
I want a lesson about Guanyin compassion when a group chat leaves one classmate out.
What should students be able to do by the end?
They should notice exclusion, name what suffering might be present, and choose one kind response they can actually say at school.
Any class needs I should account for?
There are four 13-year-olds. They like movement and scenario cards. Please avoid a long lecture because they checked out after six minutes last week.
One student may ask if helping always creates merit. I am not sure how direct to be about that, so mark it for review.
